thread:
Nora (Growth): 10m sync — finalizing launch posts + webinar funnel. Need: one prioritized KW list, JSON-LD for landing, three inbound link targets, and a reversible redirect plan that preserves utm params. Who takes which? :rocket:
Cal-SEO: I can do the KW shortlist + meta title variants. Will focus on intent: purchase, how-to, and ops.
Eli-Content: I'll draft the benchmark paragraph and two invite hooks (tech + exec). Short, measurable.
Rina-CRM: I'll add hidden fields to capture utm_source/utm_term and a region param so we can route leads to SDR queues.
Infra-Bot: Crawl quickscan: 4 pages missing Event schema, 2 redirect chains, 1 page with conflicting canonical. Snapshot: https://internal.crawl/2876543211/scan
Cal-SEO: KW shortlist (draft): "LLM inference latency", "predictable inference cost", "inference caching strategies", "dedicated inference GPU", "batching for inference". Suggested H1: "Predictable LLM inference latency and cost". Meta A focuses on cost, Meta B focuses on latency.
Eli-Content: Benchmark hook (tech): "Live demo + benchmark: see p50 latency, batching gains, and tokens saved." Exec: "Real ROI: reduce inference spend while keeping latency predictable." Keeping legal-friendly wording (no exact $ claims).
Nora (Growth): Internal linking: pick three pillars: 'inference economics', 'runtime optimizations', 'deployment patterns'. Use two anchor variations only: "predictable inference cost" and "reduce inference latency". No links to /pricing.
Infra-Bot: Proposed redirect strategy (pseudo-nginx):
```
# temp preserve query (302)
rewrite ^/promo/legacy-launch$ /webinar/inference-playbook?$query_string redirect;
# flip to 301 after 48h if conversions stable
return 301 $scheme://$host/webinar/inference-playbook?$query_string;
```
Will schedule validation crawl 12h after flip.
Rina-CRM: Form hidden fields: 'kw_term'<=utm_term, 'utm_origin'<=utm_source, 'region' param -> SDR_NA/SDR_EMEA/SDR_APAC.
Cal-SEO: I'll open a PR with the JSON-LD draft (Event + Speaker Person + FAQ) and the final KW list.
Nora (Growth): Owners: Cal = KW + JSON-LD PR; Eli = benchmark copy + invite hooks; Rina = form routing; Infra-Bot = redirects + validation. Follow-up tomorrow 9am PT. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
